description: The 2020 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 LT immediately stands out against rivals like the Ford F-150 XLT and Ram 1500 Big Horn by combining a robust EcoTec3 5.3L V8 engine, standard 4WD, and a versatile extended cab configuration. Its primary advantage lies in real-world capability-offering a balance of hauling power, comfort, and smart connectivity features that others often reserve for pricier trims. With its Shadow Gray Metallic exterior and Jet Black interior, this truck appeals to buyers who demand both reliability and modern style from their next full-size pickup.  Buyers cross-shopping top trucks will find the Silverado 1500 LT especially compelling for daily work and weekend tasks. Those who need a tough, full-size truck for hauling, towing, or navigating unpredictable weather-such as that in the greater St. Louis area-will appreciate its heavy-duty suspension and standard 4WD. The spacious extended cab offers practical usability, making it ideal for contractors, outdoor enthusiasts, or families who value adaptability and interior comfort without sacrificing capability.  Performance-wise, this truck sets itself apart by offering the EcoTec3 5.3L V8 engine paired with a smooth 8-speed automatic transmission. While some competitors may offer smaller turbocharged engines at this trim level, the Silverado's V8 delivers consistent power for towing and hauling, complemented by a responsive transmission. The auxiliary external transmission oil cooler and external engine oil cooler further enhance durability during heavy-duty tasks, giving this model a long-term advantage in demanding scenarios.  Safety is another area where this truck excels compared to others in its class. Standard features include ABS brakes, dual front and side impact airbags, electronic stability control, brake assist, and traction control. description: If you've been searching for a capable, classic American truck without breaking the bank, this 2002 Dodge Ram 1500 Quad Cab Long Bed for sale at Sunset Car Co in Santa Ana, CA might be exactly what you're looking for. With a bold red exterior, a proven V8 engine, and the versatility of the Quad Cab Long Bed configuration, this Ram 1500 checks a lot of boxes for work-ready truck buyers throughout Orange County and beyond.About This 2002 Dodge Ram 1500 Quad Cab Long Bed This Ram 1500 comes in at 126,648 miles  a very reasonable number for a truck of this era, especially given how overbuilt these early 2000s Ram trucks were designed to be. At over two decades old, a well-maintained Ram 1500 with this mileage is entirely capable of delivering years of continued use, particularly for buyers who need a reliable workhorse rather than a showpiece. The striking red exterior gives it a presence on the road that still turns heads, and the Quad Cab Long Bed body style makes it one of the most practical configurations Dodge offered in this generation. Stock #184019 is ready to be driven off the lot.2002 Dodge Ram 1500 Performance and Engine Under the hood of this Ram 1500 sits a 4.7-liter V8 engine paired with an automatic transmission  a combination that delivers smooth, confident power for everyday driving and light-to-medium duty hauling. The 4.7L PowerTech V8 was a strong step up from the base V6 option and offered a solid balance between torque and fuel efficiency for a full-size truck of this class. Paired with a two-wheel-drive drivetrain, this truck is optimized for Southern California terrain  ideal for flat highways, job sites, and city driving throughout Orange County and the surrounding region. If you're doing landscaping runs, hauling equipment, or just need a capable daily driver, the drivetrain setup works perfectly for the climate and roads here.Dodge Ram 1500 Features and InteriorQuad Cab Versatility The Quad Cab configuration gives you real rear seating access  far more usable than a standard extended cab with the awkward fold-out rear doors. Whether you're transporting coworkers to a job site or loading up the family for a weekend trip, the rear cabin space is genuinely functional. Call Our Sales Team at  for more info or to have a custom video emailed to you..Fast Out Of State Delivery Available..What the reviews say..You know Mercedes-Benz's E-class lineup strums the right nerve when were vouching for this four-seat convertible variant using its filial relationship to the lovely E400-badged station wagon. The entire six-cylinder E-class family, which also includes a four-door sedan and a two-door coupe as well as the AMG-badged E43 sports sedan, ascended to our 10Best Cars list for 2018, and for good reason: They're so incredibly well built, stylish, and luxurious that you cant help but think Mercedes could charge even more for them. Where the E400 sedan stands as a stoic totem to German luxury-sedan competence and the coupe anchors the sporty end of the lineup, the cabriolet elicits a sense of damn, Ive made it awe. Walking up to the cabriolet, pressing and holding the unlock button on the key fob, and watching the roof lower before your eyes, you'll experience a feeling similar to walking into a Ritz-Carlton hotel suite while on vacation. On other E-class models, Mercedes gorgeous interior design and fit and finish are private enjoyments for their occupants. Lower the cabrios roof, however, and they're on full display for everyone. Buyers ordering choices have an outsize effect on the visual wattage, of course. Our car came optioned, the no-cost Macchiato Beige and Yacht Blue layout with light-brown elm trim. With its blue-colored soft top, another no-cost option; red, black, and dark brown also are available, our Iridium Silver metallic E400 looked French Riviera ready. Since there are no rivieras near our Ann Arbor, Michigan, headquarters, we cruised a lot of battered roads instead. (One of those roads does run alongside a river, briefly.) These more taxing environs might not have the E400s glamour, but they certainly provided ample opportunity for the E-class's fundamental excellence to shine. Take, for example, the Benz's stout underlying structure, which survives the cabrios roof scalping with minimal flexion even when negotiating steep driveway entrances. Leave the thickly padded, fully headlined top up, and you'd swear you were in a fixed-roof coupe, so quiet is the cabin at highway speeds. Should you prod the E400 to move out in a hurry, it will. The Sport/Sport+ driving modes poke a stick in the V-6s responses and send the nine-speed automatic transmission scrambling for lower gears, cracking off zesty rev-matched downshifts along the way. It preserves the raw, manual-transmission character of the regular STI while making the cabin substantially better equipped. Amazon Web Services, Inc. Performance hardware The centerpiece is the 2.5-liter turbocharged EJ257 flat-four, producing 305 hp at 6,000 rpm and 290 lb-ft at 4,000 rpm, exclusively paired with a reinforced six-speed manual. Brembo brakes, STI-tuned suspension, Active Torque Vectoring, and 245/40R18 summer tires reinforce its focus on grip and driver involvement rather than straight-line performance alone. EPA ratings were 17 mpg city and 23 highway. Amazon Web Services, Inc. The AWD system The Driver Controlled Center Differential (DCCD) is one of the STI's defining features. Its full-time AWD system uses a nominal 41:59 front/rear torque split, with three automatic DCCD modes plus six manual differential-lock settings; a helical limited-slip front differential and Torsen limited-slip rear differential further manage power across the axles. This unusually adjustable drivetrain is a major distinction between the STI and ordinary AWD performance cars. Subaru Canada What the Limited adds The Limited keeps the STI mechanical package but adds 18-inch forged BBS wheels, leather upholstery, an eight-way power driver's seat, power moonroof, keyless access and push-button start, blind-spot monitoring with rear cross-traffic alert, navigation, and a nine-speaker Harman Kardon audio system. The vehicle is equipped with a camera that displays an image of the area behind the vehicle on an interior display. An active lane departure system alerts the driver of unintended movement of the vehicle out of a designated traffic lane and automatically maintains the vehicle's position within that lane.
